propositions: Clients running rebar CLI without a rebar checkout encounter broken internal cross-references in packaged CLI-served author guides (relative paths like review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md that have no referent outside a repo tree).

The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help and lacks a packaged guide topic comparable to plan and review.

Packaged guides in src/rebar/_guides/ must repoint all dangling repo-relative references to either rebar explain <topic> commands (for sibling guides) or canonical https://github.com URLs (for repo-only docs) to resolve for repo-less consumers.

A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES registry and served by rebar explain commit-trailer, quoting EXPECTED_FORMAT verbatim and referencing rebar verify-commit-ticket for self-checking.

Link-resolution guard tests must verify that every markdown link target in packaged guides and criterion explanations resolves for a repo-less client (only https://, http://, intra-doc anchors, and mailto: allowed; no consumer-relative paths like ](*.md) or ](docs/…)).
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring and test coverage must be updated to include commit-trailer in the discoverable guide list and assert consistency between AUTHOR_GUIDES and the MCP docstring.
